We multiply each entry of $G$ by $\frac{1}{3}$ and each entry of $H$ by $2,$ and then add the resulting matrices, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{3}G+2H & =\frac{1}{3}[\begin{aligned}3 & 6 & 15 \\ -12 & 9 & 6\end{aligned}]+2[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 5 \\ 3 & 4 & 6\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{3}\cdot 3 & \frac{1}{3}\cdot 6 & \frac{1}{3}\cdot 15 \\ \frac{1}{3}\cdot (-12) & \frac{1}{3}\cdot 9 & \frac{1}{3}\cdot 6\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}2\cdot 1 & 2\cdot 2 & 2\cdot 5 \\ 2\cdot 3 & 2\cdot 4 & 2\cdot 6\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 5 \\ -4 & 3 & 2\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}2 & 4 & 10 \\ 6 & 8 & 12\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}1+2 & 2+4 & 5+10 \\ -4+6 & 3+8 & 2+12\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}3 & 6 & 15 \\ 2 & 11 & 14\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$
